Name: Selective Eating by Cloudyluna
Author: Cloudyluna
Description:
[size=6][b]Selective Eating[/b][/size]

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

A simple quality-of-life mod to make eating easier and automatic with configurable settings.

[size=5][b]Features[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Automatically eat food when you lose some health or energy. You can configure this eating priority strategy in the menu to either prioritize replenishing the most health or energy as much as possible, the lowest priced food to save money, or turn this extra strategy off at any time.
[*]Entirely skip eating animation (and the world pauses that come with it) for you to eat food on the go, automatically. Configurable.
[*]Forbid certain food from being eaten. Configurable.
[*]Prioritize the food in your inventory’s active row for eating.
[*]An option to stay in the same facing direction even after eating.
[*]Increase or decrease eating time intervals for role-playing/challenge or performance reasons.
[*]Options can be configured through the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Config Menu[/url] or [u]config.json[/u] file within the [u]SelectiveEating[/u] mod directory.
[/list]

[size=5][b]Version[/b][/size]

0.4.3

[size=5][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]

If you found this mod behaving weirdly or being incompatible with other mods, please report it on the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26831?tab=bugs][u]bugs[/u][/url] or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26831?tab=posts][u]posts[/u][/url] page so I can update this documentation with that information and let other users know about such potential issues in the future.

[quote]
This mod should work with most other mods unless specified otherwise below.[/quote]

[size=4][b]Compatible with multiplayer?[/b][/size]

Untested.

[size=4][b]Incompatible with[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Fluent Eating
[*]Auto-eat (including the 1.6 updated version)
[/list]

[size=5][b]Known issues[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]No known issue.
[/list]

[size=5][b]What changed?[/b][/size]

See [url=https://github.com/cloudyluna/StardewValleyMods/tree/main/SelectiveEating/CHANGELOG.md]CHANGELOG.md[/url] file for details.

[size=5][b]Requirements[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6 (preferably, version 1.6.8)
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] (minimum v4.0.0 or higher)
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] - [i]Optional[/i] but [i]highly recommended[/i].
[/list]

[size=5][b]For users[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Installing SelectiveEating[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]This mod requires SMAPI, so please, install that and other listed requirements first.
[*]Unzip the files into the [b]Stardew Valley/Mods/SelectiveEating[/b] game folder.
[*]Make sure the [b]SelectiveEating.dll[/b], [b]CloudyCore.dll[/b], [b]FSharp.Core.dll[/b], and [b]manifest.json[/b] files are inside [b]SelectiveEating[/b] folder, not in [b]Mods[/b] folder.
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI launcher.
[/list]
